description: Use this tool to list, create, or close isolated DAP sessions before routing other debugger tools with sessionId. Omit sessionId on normal debug tools only when the backward-compatible default session is intended; do not use a global session selector for concurrent work.

action.description: Management action: list current sessions, create a new isolated session, or close one session.

sessionId.description: Requested ID for create, or target ID for close. Omit on create to generate a bounded session-N identifier.

terminateDebuggee.description: For close only: request debugger termination of the live target before resetting/removing the session.

name: debug_sessions
title: Manage Debug Sessions
